fields.label: Inventory name of the array
fields.help_text: The array whose object store this credential reaches, named as in the FlashBlades inventory and object_store; one credential serves one array, because the environment variables it injects have fixed names

fields.label: FlashBlade management address
fields.help_text: https://<array> or the bare address; the object-audit source reads the log target, the audit policies and the bucket quota through it

fields.label: API token
fields.help_text: Token the object-audit source uses for its REST reads (a read-only role is enough)

fields.label: S3 endpoint
fields.help_text: https://<data address> of the array's object store; path-style addressing

fields.label: Tail access key id
fields.help_text: Access key id of the identity that reads the audit log bucket (object-list, object-read, bucket-list and bucket-info)

fields.label: State access key id
fields.help_text: Access key id of the identity with full access to the eda buckets; writes the cursor copy, requests, receipts, legal holds, ledgers and drill markers
